people.name: Isaiah
people.line: Prophet during reigns of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, Hezekiah.

translations.web: The book of the prophet Isaiah was handed to him. He opened the book, and found the place where it was written,
translations.bsb: the scroll of the prophet Isaiah was handed to Him. Unrolling it, He found the place where it was written:
translations.kjv: And there was delivered unto him the book of the prophet Esaias. And when he had opened the book, he found the place where it was written,
translations.asv: And there was delivered unto him the book of the prophet Isaiah. And he opened the book, and found the place where it was written,
